# servchip.com

> ServChip is a global supplier of enterprise semiconductors and AI hardware, offering sourcing, deployment, support, and consultation for data centers, HPC, and AI workloads.

ServChip procures and distributes enterprise server chips, GPUs, and networking hardware from leading vendors including NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Supermicro, Dell, and Cisco. We provide technical consultation and bulk procurement for AI and HPC infrastructure across the globe.

## Solutions and Services

- [Enterprise Chip Solutions](https://servchip.com/services): Comprehensive enterprise chip sourcing, deployment, and support services globally.
- [Technology & Platforms](https://servchip.com/solutions): Technology overview and resources on AI, HPC, and semiconductor platforms.
- [Enterprise Chip Comparison](https://servchip.com/comparison): Compare and purchase enterprise server chips from top brands with specifications and suitability guidance.
- [Enterprise Semiconductor Procurement](https://servchip.com/faq): Procurement, support, and technical consultation for bulk AI chip and hardware purchases.

## Vendor Hardware

- [Cisco Hardware Solutions](https://servchip.com/brands/cisco): Cisco networking hardware and silicon solutions for enterprise and data center infrastructure.
- [Supermicro GPU Servers](https://servchip.com/brands/supermicro): Supermicro GPU servers for AI and HPC workloads.
- [Dell AI Server Solutions](https://servchip.com/brands/dell-technologies): Dell AI server solutions and enterprise hardware distribution.

## Insights

- [AI Hardware Insights](https://servchip.com/blog): Expert guides, comparisons, and market insights on AI hardware and GPU procurement.
